name: Pretty Donkey 11
author: ainasoa
description: Outlined gray text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 50px #ffffff, border becomes 1px solid #808080.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pretty Donkey 11</title>
<style>
/* Pretty Donkey 11 by ainasoa — https://uiverse.io/ainasoa/pretty-donkey-11 */
.input {
  max-width: 210px;
  height: 50px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  border: 0;
  outline: auto grey;
  padding-inline: 15px;
  font-size: 16px;
  transform: all 200ms;
}

.input:focus {
  text-decoration: underline 6px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgb(255, 255, 255);
  border: 1px solid grey;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Name" type="text" name="text" class="input">

</body>
</html>
